lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun ko poot pitaa ko kaa ko ||
lines.translation: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਕੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaun marai ko dei sa(n)taapo ||1||
lines.translation: Who dies? Who inflicts pain? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਠਗ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har thag jag kau thagauree laaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke biog kaise jeeau meree maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun ko purakh kaun kee naaree ||
lines.translation: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਤਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: iaa tat lehu sareer bichaaree ||2||
lines.translation: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer thag siu man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਠਗੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: gaee thagauree thag pahichaaniaa ||3||39||
lines.translation: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mo kau bhae raajaa raam sahaaee ||
lines.translation: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kat param gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਓ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat deeo ralaai ||
lines.translation: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੇ ਲੀਓ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch doot te leeo chhadaai ||
lines.translation: He has rescued me from the five demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam japau jap rasanaa ||
lines.translation: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: amol daas kar leeno apanaa ||1||
lines.translation: He has made me his own slave. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur keeno paraupakaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaadh leen saagar sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal siu laagee preet ||
lines.translation: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d basai nitaa nit cheet ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਅੰਗਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa tapat bujhiaa a(n)giaar ||
lines.translation: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sa(n)tokh naam aadhaar ||
lines.translation: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal poor rahe prabh suaamee ||
lines.translation: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jat pekhau tat a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanee bhagat aap hee driRaaee ||
lines.translation: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhat miliaa mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kripaa kare tis pooran saaj ||
lines.translation: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥੪॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee gareeb nivaaj ||4||40||
lines.translation: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal hai sootak thal hai sootak sootak opat hoee ||
lines.translation: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janame sootak mooe phun sootak sootak paraj bigoee ||1||
lines.translation: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined by pollution. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਕਉਨ ਪਵੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu re pa(n)deeaa kaun paveetaa ||
lines.translation: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa giaan japahu mere meetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainahu sootak bainahu sootak sootak sravanee hoee ||
lines.translation: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat sootak laagai sootak parai rasoee ||2||
lines.translation: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaasan kee bidh sabh kooo jaanai chhootan kee ik koee ||
lines.translation: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raam ridai bichaarai sootak tinai na hoee ||3||41||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted. ||3||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਗਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhagaraa ek niberahu raam ||
lines.translation: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau tum apane jan sau kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man badaa k jaa sau man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਡਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam badaa kai raamahi jaaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa badaa k jaas upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bed badaa k jahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer hau bhaiaa udaas ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: teerath badaa k har kaa daas ||3||42||
lines.translation: is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee chetee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Chaytee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhau bhaaee gyaan kee aaee aa(n)dhee ||
lines.translation: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhai udaanee bhram kee taatee rahai na maaiaa baa(n)dhee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: duchite kee dui thoon giraanee moh baledaa tootaa ||
lines.translation: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotional attachment have come crashing down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tisanaa chhaan paree dhar oopar duramat bhaa(n)daa phootaa ||1||
lines.translation: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ||1||
